parameters.jsCode:
const data = $input.item.json;
return [{json: {audio_url: data.audio_url, text: data.text, patient_id: data.patient_id, provider: data.provider || 'clinician', encounter_type: data.encounter_type || 'office visit'}}];

parameters.text:
=You are an ambient clinical scribe. Generate a structured SOAP note from this clinical encounter.

PATIENT ID: {{ $json.patient_id }}
ENCOUNTER TYPE: {{ $json.encounter_type }}
TRANSCRIPT: {{ $json.text || 'No transcript provided — generate from context' }}

Format as SOAP:
SUBJECTIVE: Chief complaint, HPI (OLDCARTS), ROS
OBJECTIVE: Vitals, exam findings
ASSESSMENT: Ranked differential with ICD-10 suggestions
PLAN: Orders, medications, follow-up, patient education

Include:
- Drug interaction flags if medications discussed
- Preventive care gaps (USPSTF)
- Coding suggestions (HCC/RAF where applicable)
- Header: 'DRAFT — PENDING PROVIDER REVIEW'

parameters.name: text
